kb_proposals: An E0-manifold's SingularGXStructure is GX.E0Bridge.e0SingularGXStructure (a reducible def, use letI): Reg = E0LM.e0RegM M, Sing = chartedSing e0SingY M 0, IsBTZSingModelled by isBTZSingModelled_e0; so BTZTildeData exists over any ChartedSpace E0Y M.

Causal.UniversalCover (e0RegMFlat M) x0 vs a subtype over ↑↑(e0RegM M): the types are defeq but rw fails; state results with (e0RegMFlat M) and a base point of type e0RegMFlat M (E0Bridge.regPtF), and read points of M through E0Bridge.flatVal.

To compare two chart-generated causalities, prove the charts G-compatible and use E0Bridge.chartAtlasCausality_eq_chartedCausality (agreement on chart sources + absolute minimality of chartedCausality); no curve argument is needed.
GX.xaChartToE0Y_apply carries TildeM's section instances (T2, LocPathConnected, FirstCountable, Connected); E0Bridge.xaChartToE0Y_apply_mk is the hypothesis-free form.
Inside a `letI := e0SingularGXStructure M` statement, a body starting with `(` on the next line parses as an application argument; write `letI := ...;`.
